summary.text: Brian Newberry is a Republican state representative from District 48 who took office in 2009 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Republican primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as the House minority leader and an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Newberry earned a bachelor's degree in American History and Urban Studies from the University of Pennsylvania in 1993 and a J.D. from Temple University School of Law in 1996, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes an internship at the Philadelphia United States Attorney's Office and work as a partner in the law firm Donovan Hatem LLP.
